title: Local tensor comparison with prescribed strictly perfect models
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U an open. Give the categories of O_X-modules and of modules on the localized site over U derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let P,N be K-flat complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let A,B be strictly perfect complexes on the localized site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with prescribed isomorphisms R(Q(P)) ≅ Q(A) and R(Q(N)) ≅ Q(B), where R is exact open restriction. Then R(Q(Tot(P tensor N))) ≅ Q(Tot(A tensor B)), with the actual sheaf tensor total complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. No point, covering, affine hypothesis or perfectness assertion is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Tag 09J5 local model argument and Tag 06YH derived tensor construction; restriction is Tag 06YC and the local calculation of schemes.tex Tag 08DX

proof.text: Apply localizedOpen_kFlat_tensor_restriction to P,N. This yields K-flat termwise restrictions P′,N′ and an isomorphism from the derived restriction of the global total tensor to Q(Tot(P′ tensor N′)).

Prove strictPerfect_isKFlat_local directly on the localized category. The two bounds give IsStrictlyGE and IsStrictlyLE. Each finite free term is flat by flat_coproduct and flatness of the unit, and each term of A is flat by flat_of_retract. Apply the proved upstream CochainComplex.kFlat_of_bounded_of_flat, then HomotopyCategory.kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic to recover the recorded one-sided sheaf IsKFlat criterion. No ringed-space transport is needed.

For the private local_kFlat_tensor_invariance helper, K-flatness of the fixed second factor N′ makes tensoring quasi-isomorphisms in the first variable quasi-isomorphisms: apply the cone criterion, the definition of IsKFlat, and mapBifunctorMappingCone₁Iso. For fixed first factor A, apply the same cone criterion after the signed symmetry of total tensor; construct this symmetry from the termwise sheaf braiding and mapBifunctorFlipIso. Then mapBifunctorMappingCone₂Iso gives quasi-isomorphism preservation in the second variable. Localize these two fixed-factor functors followed by Q with Localization.lift and Localization.fac. Applying the lifted functors to the two prescribed input isomorphisms gives Q(Tot(P′ tensor N′)) ≅ Q(Tot(A tensor B)). This uses no derived monoidal structure or choice of flat resolutions.

Compose each inverse overFunctor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors component with eA or eB to obtain the input isomorphisms for the local invariance helper. Compose its output with the restriction isomorphism from the first step. All types and universes match the original conclusion. The strict-perfect hypothesis on B stays in the unchanged interface, although the fixed-factor argument already needs only strict perfectness of A and K-flatness of the restricted N.

theorem strictPerfect_tensor_localComparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (hN : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N)
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hA : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U A) (hB : Scheme.IsStrictlyPerfect X U B)
    (eA : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj A))
    (eB : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)) :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N
          (@curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) _
            (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)))) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor A B
        (@curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) _
          (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (X.sheaf.over U)))))
